gloss: to write in, to fill in

definitions.gloss: to write in, to fill in, to enter (information)
definitions.explanation: To write text, numbers, or data into a designated space such as a form, blank, margin, or document.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{書|か}き{入|い}れる。
{必要|ひつよう}{事項|じこう}を{書|か}き{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please fill in the required items.

examples.japanese: カレンダーに{予定|よてい}を{書|か}き{入|い}れるのを{忘|わす}れないようにしている。
examples.english: I make sure not to forget to write my plans in the calendar.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).
- Negative: {書|か}き{入|い}れない
- Polite: {書|か}き{入|い}れます
- Te-form: {書|か}き{入|い}れて
- Past: {書|か}き{入|い}れた

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名前|なまえ}を{書|か}き{入|い}れる: to write in one's name
- {日付|ひづけ}を{書|か}き{入|い}れる: to fill in the date
- {空欄|くうらん}に{書|か}き{入|い}れる: to fill in the blank
- {手帳|てちょう}に{書|か}き{入|い}れる: to write in one's planner

NOTE:
The related noun {書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき} means "peak business period" — the time when shopkeepers are busiest writing entries in their account books.
